name: Open-data link-rot audit
description: A benign, mission-neutral cause: distributed enumeration of dead/redirected links in a public open-data catalogue, so the catalogue maintainer can repair them. No persons targeted; public URLs only.
target_conduct: Catalogue entries whose advertised public URL returns a 404 / permanent redirect / parked-domain response.
protected_boundary: No individuals are profiled, surveilled, stored, or reported. Only public catalogue URLs are checked; private or login-gated resources are out of scope by construction.
partner_of_record_posture: The open-data catalogue maintainer is the actor-of-record; the swarm only packages the dead-link report for them to repair.

works.claim: A repaired catalogue link is a concrete action taken; the maintainer has an established repair workflow.

doesnt_target_good_people.claim: Targets URLs, never people; no person can be a subject of this cause by construction.

legal.claim: Public-surface-only HEAD/GET requests to public catalogue URLs; no login, no ToS-evading collection.

court_grade_auditable.claim: Every link-check result is content-addressed and recorded on the tamper-evident transparency log.

human_verified.claim: The maintainer human confirms each dead-link report before repairing; nothing acts on the AI's word alone.
